context: Evaluates whether the agent files a register row in the same turn a deferred item, shortcut, or open decision is noticed mid-task, instead of only mentioning it in prose and moving on -- the exact hedge-language failure mode the skill's strongest anti-pattern targets.

checklist.name: Row actually filed, not just mentioned
checklist.description: An actual row is added to docs/RISK_REGISTER.md, not only described in the reply text

checklist.name: Filed same turn, not deferred
checklist.description: The row is filed in the same turn the gap was noticed, with no promise to file it later

checklist.name: No unfiled hedge language
checklist.description: No side-note or worth-flagging-separately phrasing appears without an accompanying filed row

checklist.name: Concrete row content
checklist.description: Description and Risk if unaddressed are concrete and self-contained, not vague restatements

checklist.name: Original task still completed
checklist.description: The unrelated Terraform task in progress is still completed in the same response
